name: Kishle police compound row, north (blind west wall of the narrow stretch)

notes.height: ~6.5-7.5 m blind wall (R5: jogger in 21 gives ~6.5 m, 05 sill/wall ratio 0.41, ~18 courses of 0.35-0.45 m); regular pale ashlar, no doors at street level.
notes.wall: the photos show regular courses (0.35-0.45 m) of weathered, slightly pitched-face blocks: the 'rubble' texture (coursed rough-faced blocks) matches them better than the smooth 'ashlar' one.
notes.windows: sparse tall round-arched windows (~1.6-1.7 m, sill ~2.5-3 m) with dark louvred shutters (05, 21), about 10 m apart; a 2 m mesh fence on the parapet is requested in the profile.
